description: List available StatCan cubes (tables) — lean: productId + title (en/fr) + CANSIM id + dimension count + release date. Use the productId with statcan_cube_metadata / statcan_cube_data. StatCan has ~8,000 cubes and its endpoint has no paging of its own, so this tool pages for you: pass `title` to search by name (recommended — it is the fast way to the handful you want), or walk `page`. Default 200 per page; `has_more` tells you whether more exist.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the English and French cube titles, e.g. "egg" or "population". Applied to the cubes scanned on this page.

name: statcan_list_cubes

count.description: Cubes returned on THIS page (not the catalogue total -- StatCan's endpoint has no paging, so this tool streams and pages; use has_more/next_page)

has_more.description: True when more cubes exist beyond this page

next_page.description: Next page number, or null at the end

note.description: Present when the scan was truncated: says what was scanned and how to narrow

scan_truncated.description: True when the read stopped at the cap rather than the end of the upstream array, so a short page is OUR ceiling and not proof the list ended

scanned.description: Cubes read off the upstream stream before stopping -- the bound that keeps this call from holding StatCan's whole 8 MB array in memory

title_filter.description: The lower-cased title substring applied, or null

upstream_bytes_read.description: Bytes actually pulled from StatCan WDS for this call

title: Statcan List Cubes
